campaigns.title: Smart Watch for Athletes
campaigns.description: A next-generation smartwatch designed specifically for endurance athletes. Tracks heart rate, VO2 max, sleep quality, and nutrition intake. Built with a lightweight titanium frame and a 10-day battery life.

campaigns.title: Eco-Friendly Packaging Startup
campaigns.description: We are building a line of 100% compostable food packaging from agricultural waste. Our products replace single-use plastic in restaurants and supermarkets across Egypt and the MENA region.

campaigns.title: Online Arabic Coding Bootcamp
campaigns.description: A 12-week intensive coding bootcamp taught entirely in Arabic covering HTML, CSS, JavaScript and React. Targeting students in underserved communities with limited access to English-language resources.

campaigns.title: Mobile Veterinary Clinic
campaigns.description: A van-based mobile vet service for stray and owned animals in rural areas outside Cairo. Will offer vaccinations, spay/neuter, and basic treatment at zero or minimal cost. Operated by licensed veterinarians.

campaigns.title: 3D-Printed Prosthetic Hands
campaigns.description: We design and distribute free 3D-printed prosthetic hands for children who cannot afford traditional prosthetics. Each hand costs under $50 to print and can be fitted in under an hour.

campaigns.title: Community Rooftop Garden
campaigns.description: Turning unused rooftop space in Downtown Cairo into a shared urban farm. Residents will grow vegetables, herbs and fruit using hydroponic and soil-based beds. Surplus produce donated to local food banks.
